Fandom (indianajones.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://indianajones.fandom.com/wiki/Indiana_Jones_and_the_Great_Circle
notes: Backlog game, added from the docs/PLAN.md candidate list. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0), with Walkthrough and Characters subpages linked but barely written. indianajones.fandom.com answers the API, with about 500 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 28 of 55 Steam achievements are hidden; 4 named for the Order of Giants expansion are sorted by name, and the rest sit in the main story chapter. Some are likely side mysteries (fieldwork) and need checking.
